editorial:
Imagine a blue blur of energy crashing into a small town and causing a total blackout. That is how you meet Sonic, a lonely alien hedgehog who just wants a friend. You will quickly fall in love with his high energy and the way he bonds with Tom, a local cop who becomes his big brother figure. The vibe is light, colorful, and feels like a giant hug. It does not try to be too deep; it just wants to make you smile while watching a fast little guy cause chaos in the real world.

Jim Carrey is the real star here, bringing back that wild energy from his old movies as the evil Dr. Robotnik. The action scenes are snappy, though some of the CGI looks a bit too smooth in spots. If you have a family or just want something easy to watch, you will have a blast. To get the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all those bright colors pop. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for movie night.
endingExplained: After a wild chase, Sonic uses his powers to overload Robotnik's giant robot, causing it to explode. Sonic sends the villain flying through a portal to the Mushroom Planet, leaving him stranded far away from Earth. With the bad guy gone, Sonic is finally accepted by the town. He finds a true home with Tom and Maddie, and the movie ends with him getting a map to find his other friends.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves video games, cute characters, and lighthearted action.
